Why one lot is not the same as thirteen lots. Most beginners think position size does not matter, but it decides how much you can lose on one bad trade.

Suppose one lot costs 100 rupees per point. Thirteen lots cost 1300 rupees per point, so a ten point move changes your account by 13000 rupees instead of 1000.

Always size your position before you enter. Decide your maximum loss first, then divide by the risk per lot. This keeps one mistake from ending your account.
